mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.created_date DESC) AS rank_num, r.*, m.nickname FROM recipe r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY r.created_date DESC LIMIT 5;
select r.*, c.category_name, f.food_name from recipe_view r join food f on r.food_id = f.food_id join category c on c.category_id = f.category_id where r.recipe_id = #{recipe_id}
